name: hdie_pc_ctrl_mc3c6_s350-mc3c6_s350-COMMIT
purpose: MC3c v6 keeps POST_REG=1 and ACT_HEAD=1. Each ACT eligibility operand and destination uses kept same-edge bank captures; seven destination groups bound row controls to ten bits. Four equivalent head-bank next muxes use kept regional forwarding identities and serve local look-bank/ACT captures. Independent kept head banks drive queue successor and plus2 eligibility; tail command decode serves four banks. No additional cycle over MC3c; +1 post edge over MC3b remains priced. v3/v4/v5 failed native census evidence is preserved.
